title: Filtering Active Catalog Products with WHERE
realWorldScenario: Merchandising wants an active products list excluding discontinued or archived inventory.
questionStatement: Write a query to retrieve the `sku`, `name`, and `price` of all products from `products` where `is_active` is true and `price` is greater than 100.00, sorted by `price` descending.
starterCode:
-- Find active products with price > 100
SELECT
  sku,
  name,
  price
FROM products
WHERE is_active = true AND price > 100
ORDER BY price DESC;
hints: Use the AND operator to satisfy both conditions simultaneously.
Sort using ORDER BY price DESC.
